planned_terminal_note: Forecast-plan target only; actual state is never reset or topped up to meet this target
valuation_note: Non-cash comparison diagnostic: discharge_efficiency * mean(daily price); also report min/max price sensitivity
cold_start: Jan 1 has zero ordinary purchase plan; causal PV-first battery execution and emergency supply maintain load

randomness: none; fixed settings, not tuned on February outcomes
